function.name: mcp__daab__kg_get_master_record
function.description: Get a project's MASTER RECORD — the latest active derived_record, a satellite's finished analysis (e.g. an AAA Master Record with summary / strengths / risks / recommendation). Use this FIRST for whole-project questions (overview, risks, recommendation) and present it faithfully instead of re-deriving one from raw nodes. For an aaaa_master_record, properties.record_body embeds structured sections after the prose — including a `## risk` block whose JSON has redFlags[] (each with topic, a severity of critical|warning|info, description, sourceDocFiles) and openQuestions[]; when asked to count, list, or classify risks, read that redFlags[] array — do NOT count from the prose summary and do NOT fabricate a total. Returns {"master_record": <node>} when present, or {"master_record": null, "hint": ...} when the project has none — then fall back to kg_search / kg_query on the graph.

subtype.description: Optional: narrow to a record kind, e.g. aaaa_master_record. Omit to get the latest record of any subtype.

function.name: mcp__daab__kg_get_neighbors

include_cross_project.description: Include neighbors from other projects connected via cross-project edges

view.description: Response verbosity: 'full' (default, all fields) or 'slim' (id, project_id, node_type, title, status, scope, edge_id, edge_type, direction).

project_id.description: Project ID (optional, uses default if omitted)

project_id.description: Optional project id (falls back to the default project)

function.name: mcp__daab__kg_search
function.description: Search KG nodes by concept, decision, task, document, or keyword. Use `mode` to select fulltext (default), semantic (vector), or hybrid — pass `project_id` and `query` as the minimum.

cross_project_ids.description: Additional project IDs to include in cross-project search

include_headline.description: Include ts_headline contextual snippets in results

mode.description: Search mode: 'fulltext' (default, ts_rank), 'semantic' (vector cosine over section embeddings), or 'hybrid' (RRF fusion of both). Takes precedence over 'semantic'; semantic=true is equivalent to mode=semantic.

node_types.description: Filter search to specific node types

semantic.description: Run semantic vector search over section embeddings (text query is embedded server-side at 384-dim) instead of full-text

function.name: mcp__daab__kg_search_chunks
function.description: Search document passages for the exact text to cite in an answer; returns passage text with section and line location. Use instead of kg_search when you need a verbatim quote.

document_id.description: Optional: restrict to one document (hub UUID from a kg_search result)

mode.description: Retrieval mode: fulltext | semantic | hybrid (default hybrid)

project_id.description: Optional project id (falls back to the default project)

function.name: mcp__daab__kg_search_sessions
function.description: Search conversation history via Vietnamese-correct full-text search. Returns raw windowed snippets, most relevant first, no summarization. Project scope is resolved from the API key. Use scope='monitoring' (admin only) to search across all users in the project.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a prior next_cursor

include_archived.description: Include archived threads in results (default false: archived threads are excluded)

query.description: What to search for in past conversations

scope.description: Search scope: 'user' (default, own sessions only) or 'monitoring' (all users in project, requires admin role)

function.name: mcp__daab__kg_upsert_derived_record
function.description: Upsert a satellite-computed record (e.g. AAA Master Record) as a derived_record node. Idempotent by (source_system, record_ref). Provenance edges are supplied inline via links[] and REPLACE the node's existing derived_from/evidence edges — send the complete current set on every call.

blank_summary.description: Explicitly clear summary to empty string (distinct from omitting summary, which leaves it unchanged)

generated_at.description: RFC3339 timestamp when the source system generated this record

links.description: Provenance edges for this record. REPLACES the node's complete current derived_from/evidence edge set on every call — omit to clear all provenance edges.

record_body.description: Full record body. Stored in the KG but deliberately NOT full-text indexed — do not send this as `content`, which the search trigger would index.

record_ref.description: External id (idempotency key), e.g. AAA EntityProfile.id

summary.description: Short summary; set alongside record_body, which is stored (non-indexed) in the KG
